bio: Sao Mai Nguyen is an associate professor at Ensta-Paris. She is interested in robotics, artificial intelligence and cognitive science. She tries to bridge these 3 aspects in her work, and started working in cognitive developmental robotics. She has a special interest in linking research of machine learning, robotic embodiment, child development psychology and neuroscience.
